chapters.title: The supremacy of Christ
chapters.summary: Paul prays for the Colossians and praises Christ, the image of the invisible God, in whom all things were created and hold together, who reconciled all things by His cross.

chapters.title: Complete in Christ
chapters.summary: In Christ dwells all the fullness of God, and you are complete in Him. Do not be taken captive by empty philosophy or human rules.

chapters.title: Set your mind above
chapters.summary: Set your mind on things above. Put off anger and lies, put on compassion and forgiveness, and let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts. Whatever you do, do it heartily.

chapters.title: Seasoned with salt
chapters.summary: Continue in prayer with thanksgiving. Let your speech be gracious, seasoned with salt. Paul sends greetings from his co-workers.
